title: Frank R NDE 6828
content: My experience happened after the incident. The incident was a serious car crash when my small car was in a head on collision with a delivery truck. We were both driving at forty miles per hour. Later on I was getting ready for work. I looked at my clock and the time was 4:44 AM. Suddenly I was in a room filled with a light that I can only describe as ‘all light’. The light felt as if it had a sentience and there were no shadows. The light also has the most powerful feeling of joy in a way I cannot explain. I felt a presence in The light. I asked the light if I was dead, and remember that I was not sad when I asked. A voice, which was not audible but which I felt, told me that I had many more years left on the earth. I remember feeling intense despair when I asked the light if I had to go back. I have a wife and two small children and I would later have a hard time coming to terms with the fact that despite this I did not want to come back. I then sensed the light smiling. I suddenly and violently woke up and was seated in my car looked at the deflated airbag and glass everywhere. I had a hard time waking up. When I got out of my car, I woke up and looked at my clock and the time was 4:59 AM yet only seemed like I was out for seconds. I later saw a therapist for this, a therapist who is very spiritual and believes in near death experiences. She informed me that the numbers 444 have the very powerful meaning of angels protecting us.

arrival.other_being_detail: A sentient-feeling light/presence communicated that he had many more years left on Earth.

environment.environment_other_detail: A room filled with “all light,” with no shadows; the light carried a powerful feeling of joy.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: He “suddenly and violently woke up” back in the car.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Head-on collision between his small car and a delivery truck (both about 40 mph).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: He reported seeing the time 4:44 AM before the light-room experience and 4:59 AM upon awakening in the crashed car.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: The experience is described as occurring later (after the crash) while getting ready for work, then a sudden return to the crash scene in the car.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: The NDE-like episode is described as happening after the crash while preparing for work, followed by abrupt awakening back in the crashed car; notable focus on the numbers 4:44 and 4:59.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Suddenly I was in a room filled with a light that I can only describe as ‘all light’.”; “The light felt as if it had a sentience and there were no shadows.”; “A voice, which was not audible but which I felt, told me that I had many more years left on the earth.”; “I then sensed the light smiling.”; “I suddenly and violently woke up and was seated in my car looked at the deflated airbag and glass everywhere.”
